summary: self-serve-install-and-docs: grilled 2026-08-27 (roadmap review; day-two operations; self-improvement by proposal) — two AskUserQuestion rounds, eight questions.
gaps: Security packet thin; CLI role after console undefined; Day-0 undocumented
resolutions: DOCS-1 SECURITY additions, Day-0 page, CLI as break-glass/automation/agent surface (0145); PKG-1 SBOM/licence/NOTICE (0149)

rounds.question: SELF-1 — when an AI employee proposes a change to itself, what is the default for a new agent?
options: Review-only by default; owner opts specific classes into auto-apply (Recommended)
Auto-apply persona and intro text by default; review for routines and model
Review-only, no auto-apply at all in V1.0.x
rounds.chosen: Review-only by default; owner opts specific classes into auto-apply (Recommended)

rounds.question: INCIDENT-1 — what does `freeze` do to work already in flight?
options: Soft by default: no new runs or tool calls, in-flight turns finish; `--hard` cancels immediately (Recommended)
Hard only: cancel everything immediately
Soft only
rounds.chosen: Soft by default: no new runs or tool calls, in-flight turns finish; `--hard` cancels immediately (Recommended)

rounds.question: ADMIN-ALERT-1 — where do admin alerts go in V1.0?
options: One Teams/Slack conversation only (Recommended)
Teams/Slack plus email
Teams/Slack plus a webhook sink

rounds.question: OPS-DR-1 — where do backups go?
options: S3-compatible bucket or local path, operator's choice (Recommended)
Local path only in V1.0
S3-compatible only
rounds.chosen: S3-compatible bucket or local path, operator's choice (Recommended)

rounds.question: LIFECYCLE-1 — default retention when the operator sets nothing?
options: Messages 90 days, memory until offboarding, audit 400 days minimum (Recommended)
Keep everything until explicitly purged
Messages 30 days, memory 90 days, audit 1 year
rounds.chosen: Messages 90 days, memory until offboarding, audit 400 days minimum (Recommended)

rounds.question: INTRO-1 — when does the intro card post in a channel?
options: Once, on install, plus on first @mention by any new person (Recommended)
Only on install
On install and pinned; DM everyone in the channel
rounds.chosen: Once, on install, plus on first @mention by any new person (Recommended)

rounds.question: REVISION-1 — who can restore a prior persona/access revision?
options: Owner for persona; administrator for access (Recommended)
Administrator only for both
Owner or administrator for both
rounds.chosen: Owner for persona; administrator for access (Recommended)

rounds.question: Anything else to settle before I confirm these eleven specs and open the PR?
options: No — confirm and open the PR (Recommended)
Hold — I want to change something first
rounds.chosen: No — confirm and open the PR (Recommended)
